name: Henry Lamar
bio: a Representative from Georgia; born in Clinton, Jones County, Ga., July 10, 1798; pursued an academic course; studied law; was admitted to the bar and commenced practice in Macon, Ga.; member of the State house of representatives; elected as a Jacksonian candidate to the Twenty-first Congress to fill the vacancy caused by the resignation of George R. Gilmer; reelected to the Twenty-second Congress and served from December 7, 1829, to March 3, 1833; unsuccessful candidate for reelection in 1832 to the Twenty-third Congress; unsuccessful candidate for Governor in 1857; judge of the State superior court, 1857-1861; died in Macon, Ga., August 30, 1861; interment in Rose Hill Cemetery.
